This markdown imports the raw RLS benthic data and adds variables required for the summary analyses presented in the GOC NESP report.

# Libraries
Required libraries.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(vegan)
```

# data
Load data - this is the raw benthic data sent to the project team by RLS.
```{r}
# Load raw benthic data provided by RLS
benthic_raw <- read_csv("../raw_data/RLS_GOC_benthicdata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# Initial data inspection
glimpse(benthic_raw)

# Inspect unique sites present
benthic_raw %>% distinct(site_code)
benthic_raw %>% distinct(site_name)
```
Note on Missing Sites: GC10 and GC11 (Foggy Bottom and Chinamans) are absent from the raw benthic dataset; verification confirms no benthic survey data were collected for these specific sites.


# Add year as a variable
Useful for comparing survey times/years and including as a random effect in formal statistical analysis.
```{r}
# Convert survey dates and extract year as a factor for random effects
benthic_processed <- benthic_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    survey_date = as.Date(dmy(survey_date)),
    year = as.factor(year(survey_date)),
    site_code = as.factor(site_code),
    depth = as.factor(depth)
  )
```

Note on Transect Structure: The raw data lack replicate percentage cover values per individual RLS transect, containing only overall summary percent covers. Consequently, standard errors (SEM) cannot be computed directly at the transect replicate level.

# Import cleaned survey metadata
This adds useful variables to the benthic data to enable figure production e.g. percent cover per site of interest.
```{r}
survey_meta <- read_csv("../raw_data/GOC_survey_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() 

# Select necessary spatial and environmental metadata variables
survey_meta_clean <- survey_meta %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    site_code, reef_name, area, ecoregion, realm, location, 
    lat, long, zone, region, sector, situation, 
    depth_morph, geomorph, Harris_site, report_site
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(site_code = as.factor(site_code))

```

# Merge benthic data with site metadata
```{r}
# Clean, select, and rename variables to align with metadata structures
benthic_subset <- benthic_processed %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    site_code, site_name, survey_date, depth, visibility, hour, 
    program, database, RLS_category, RLE_category, 
    total_points, num_points, percent_cover, year
  ) %>% 
  rename(
    depth_m = depth, 
    reef_name = site_name
  )

# Merge benthic data with survey metadata
benthic_merged <- left_join(benthic_subset, survey_meta_clean, by = c("site_code", "reef_name"))

# Check for missing values or unmatched records
summary(is.na(benthic_merged))
benthic_merged %>% filter(is.na(visibility))

# Identify distinct survey depths (representing the two transects per survey) and assign a transect identifier
benthic_transects <- benthic_merged %>% 
  group_by(site_code, year) %>% 
  mutate(transect_1 = as.numeric(factor(depth_m)))
```

# Format bethic categories
```{r}
benthic_categorized <- benthic_transects %>% 
  mutate(
    RLS_category = as.factor(RLS_category),
    RLE_category = as.factor(RLE_category)
  )

# Review factor levels
levels(benthic_categorized$RLS_category)
levels(benthic_categorized$RLE_category)
```

# Crosswalk to new custom categories
The report has chosen to present taxon-morpho categories. Import csv of categories to enable crosswalk
```{r}
# Import custom crosswalk categories required for the report
benthic_cats <- read_csv("../analysis_data/RLS_benthic_cats_crosswalk.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
  as.data.frame() 

# Join custom categories to the main dataset
benthic_final <- left_join(benthic_categorized, benthic_cats, by = "RLS_category")
```

# Write
```{r}
write.csv(data.5, "../analysis_data/RLS_benthic_analysis_ready.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
